# PhotoSwipe

Pinned self-hosted runtime files from PhotoSwipe 5.4.4:

- `photoswipe-lightbox.esm.min.js`
- `photoswipe.esm.min.js`
- `photoswipe.css`
- `LICENSE`

Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/photoswipe/v/5.4.4>

The files are committed so the gallery works on GitHub Pages without a CDN or a JavaScript build step. To update, inspect the release notes, run `npm pack photoswipe@VERSION`, and replace the three files above from the package's `dist/` directory together with its license.
